note: Two real 0x06 frames off a JK_B2A8S20P, hardware 19H, software 19.10, captured 2026-08-01 with three bare 0xA7 requests. The frame carries no serial and no ASCII of any kind, so it is committed verbatim. `full` is a whole page of twelve records; `tail` is the end of the ring, where the count byte drops below twelve. Timestamps in these frames were matched against the vendor app's own CSV export by value fingerprint over 137 records, which is what fixes the epoch: the app renders each record one hour later than a naive reading of the counter from 2020-01-01, so the counter is absolute seconds from the instant that was local midnight in Europe/Zagreb, and the offset to apply is the zone's standard +60 rather than the +120 in force during summer.
